did_you_know: John Gadsby Chapman's two sons were also artists.
description: Artist John Gadsby Chapman spent much of his career in Italy, and many of his images of its people and countryside were sold to American tourists. He created approximately 10 versions of Harvest on the Roman Campagna,a composition that depicts several workers amid a cut field of wheat. In the center, a team of horses threshes the grain by trampling on it.
